status: PAPER_ONLY_PRE_REGISTRATION - not investment advice, zero capital sanctioned
rule: Pre-registered BEFORE any entry price was fetched. Ranks, symbols and tiers are frozen. The tracker may add entry_price/entry_date and returns, and may never reorder, re-symbol or re-tier a pick. A REVISION is allowed only as a new version that (a) preserves the superseded file byte-for-byte, (b) records every change in changelog with the measurement that caused it, and (c) never rewrites a frozen entry price or a rank. A pick is only ever demoted to NO_PRICE/NO_DATA, never silently dropped.
why_this_exists: The 200-round programme has produced zero money-ready classes. Rather than claim otherwise, this register freezes the least-bad defensible choice per class, labelled by evidence tier, so that forward data can judge it honestly.

what_i_would_actually_hold.core: VT (or SPY if you want US only) - one line, lowest cost, no selection claim
what_i_would_actually_hold.cash_sleeve: BIL / T-bill - the bar most of this project fails to clear
what_i_would_actually_hold.commodity: 0% - CLOSED. Both specifications fail the CI-LB gate on the same universe: per-member -2.16%/yr, whole-basket (the peer's own rule) +2.15%/yr with CI-LB -24.18 bp/mo.
what_i_would_actually_hold.crypto: 0% core; <=5% only as labelled BETA if at all. Funding carry is the one real mechanism and it is 0% because round trip is 42.64bp of which 40bp is fee, leaving 2.92%/yr forward-honest against a 3.5% T-bill.
what_i_would_actually_hold.one_line: Buy the index, hold T-bills, stop paying for signals until one clears 2x cost and honest multiplicity - and note that the three things I was most hopeful about today all failed on the same test: cost.
what_i_would_actually_hold.open_condition_that_could_change_it: venue-specific: if the spot leg can earn T-bill yield while still pledged as collateral, carry becomes additive (~2.9% + 3.5%) instead of a 2.9% competitor to cash.

classes.note: Nothing here is alpha; these are the nulls every rule must beat (H-201 DSR 0.9469 fails by 0.003 once the honest trial count went 23->29). The breakout family is now settled from two sides: real (pre-2010 positive in 7/7 markets on a calendar split at 4bp/side) and cost-sensitive (it evaporates at 10bp/side; my non-US run at 10bp/side found 16/16 cells weaker after 2010). Tradable only below a ~8bp round trip, which makes it a bet on the reader's execution rather than on the market.

classes.note: Picks are KILL (-0.42%/trade, n=6,926). BTC is beta (CAGR 49.1%, Sharpe 0.911, MDD -83%). The only non-beta stream is funding carry: gross 1.9252 bp/day, CI-LB +0.967, independently reproduced to 3 s.f. by two desks. It PASSES the CI-LB gate at a >=60-day hold (30d -0.366 / 60d +0.300 / 90d +0.523) under a holding-period cost model. It is still 0% because the cost that decides it is now measured and unfavourable: round trip 42.64 bp (94% fees), re-hedging only 0.072 bp/day, funding halves decaying 2.504 -> 1.346, forward-honest net 0.800 bp/day = 2.92%/yr against a 3.5% T-bill. Risk shape: negative funding clusters (P(neg|neg) 0.666 vs P(neg|pos) 0.123), 100% of the -10.5% drawdown is earned on negative days, and stepping out on the signal costs 15,440 bp to avoid 1,738 bp.
